title: Chapter 359: Sky-Reaching Light Pillar
content:
Chapter 359: Sky-Reaching Light Pillar

These eighteen pillars of light pierced the sky, but the height could not be seen at a glance, and each of them had a width of seven or eight meters. They looked like pillars of the sky, very mighty.

After the 18 beams of light appeared, they immediately surrounded the surrounding area for several miles, enveloping most of Tomita Yoshinari's tens of thousands of troops, only a small number of three or four thousand people were not covered by the beams of light.

When the soldiers below saw the beam of light appearing, they panicked all of a sudden.

It's not that they haven't seen warriors with high cultivation and strength fighting. Although they are exaggerated, their strength is like gods and demons, but they are not as terrifying and dense as the eighteen pillars of light.

Immediately afterwards, what made these soldiers even more horrified was that after the eighteen pillars of light connected the sky and the earth, dense silk threads suddenly burst out.

These silk threads are composed of strips of white light, extremely slender, about the thickness of a human finger, but they are extremely numerous and extremely long, tens of thousands of white silk threads pop out from each beam of light.

Afterwards, these silk threads seemed to be endless, stretched rapidly, and circled towards other beams of light.

The other beams of light also stretched out silk threads and entangled with the extended white threads, gradually weaving into a big net.

This big white net is so huge that it covers the entire area with a radius of seven or eight miles. And the grid is extremely dense, and the exposed gaps can't even stretch out the clenched fist.

It didn't take long, from the appearance of these beams of light to the stretching out of the filaments to weave the large white net, it took only about ten minutes. The speed was so fast that people couldn't react to it.

Even after seeing the beam of light, many soldiers just stared there, not knowing how to react, as if they were stupid.

Then he just watched helplessly as the beam of light stretched out a silk thread, twisted into a big net to completely wrap them in, sealing off their escape route.

After the big net was completed and there was no more movement, these soldiers came back to their senses, and then there was a burst of loud crying.

The appearance of this kind of beam of light is too frightening, like a punishment from heaven, it suddenly appeared in the sky and earth, and then enveloped them.

"Quiet, give me peace! Anyone who makes noise and disturbs the morale of the army will be killed immediately."

Tomita Yoshinari frowned. He was already uneasy because of the sudden ambush, but after hearing the noise from the surrounding soldiers, he became more irritable and couldn't help shouting sharply.

It's a pity that even though he mobilized the internal force in his body, his voice reached the ears of every soldier. But the sudden appearance of the beam of light was too frightening, and many soldiers were so distracted that they couldn't listen to it at all.

So although a small number of people settled down after hearing it, most of them were still in a mess.

Many people ran around like headless chickens, as if they wanted to find a way out, but this made the originally neat formation even more chaotic.

Many people have even fallen to the mountain because of pushing and shoving, and many people were pushed to the ground and trampled to death.

The development of this situation is very bad. If it continues to be allowed to continue, it will only increase the fear in the soldiers' hearts, and finally completely collapse the army from within, becoming a lamb waiting to be caught.

Something must be done.

Tomita Yoshinari had this idea in mind.

I saw a blood-colored light gathered in his hands, which was extremely rich, and there was even a hint of cold and murderous resentment in it, which made people feel a kind of creepy fear when standing around them.

Then with a flick of both hands, the bloody light flew past the guards in front of him, split into several lines, and landed among the most chaotic crowd of soldiers.

As soon as the blood light landed, it shone brightly, covering dozens of soldiers around.

In an instant, amidst the screams of these soldiers, the figure of each soldier shrouded in blood light dried up at a speed visible to the naked eye, and finally turned into a dry bone, which was sucked alive by the blood light into a mummy .

This sudden scene immediately calmed down the surrounding soldiers who were still chaotic and noisy, and made them stop screaming with their mouths open. Na na, they were speechless, and they were completely shocked.

Just now, because of the appearance of the beam of light, they were in a state of mind, but the beam of light did not do anything to hurt them after all. Even though they knew that the appearance of this beam of light must have some kind of harm, and it was very likely to be fatal, so they screamed and ran in panic.

But the sudden appearance of blood was inexplicable. In an extremely terrifying way, it took the lives of dozens of colleagues around them. This is a more terrifying thing than the appearance of the beam of light. How can we not make them more afraid.

Immediately afterwards, after killing more than a hundred soldiers who were in chaos because of the blood that appeared, they calmed down the other soldiers who followed in panic.

Another loud voice reached the ears of every soldier, and this time everyone listened attentively without making any noise.

"Listen to me. Now the army has been surrounded. All the soldiers have returned to their commanders to accept assignments. They must not disturb the formation and make no noise. Those who disobey the order will end up with the former."

This was the voice of their chief general Tomita Yoshinari, and every soldier could hear it clearly, without any omissions or mistakes.

This voice was not the first time they had heard it.

Ever since Yoshinari Tomita accepted the command of their army, they have heard orders from this voice no less than ten times. I have been familiar with it for a long time, and I am so familiar with it that I can't be more familiar with it.

Only now did he suddenly realize that it was the general who had killed those soldiers just now, and he couldn't help but feel a surge of emotion in his heart, and he no longer dared to act in a panic.

After all, they became soldiers after undergoing strict training. When these soldiers were trained in the barracks, they were clearly informed of the harshness of the military law and the fate of violating the military law.

In the past, after many colleagues violated the military law with disapproval, and were shocked by the scene of punishment, they had long had a deep-seated fear of the military law in their hearts, and they dared not violate it like a tiger.

But now they have released a lot of military laws, which seriously disturbed the morale of the army, which attracted the main general to kill those disorderly soldiers to frighten them.

Now after this deterrent, many soldiers have calmed down, and they can't help but feel a bit of fear and gratitude, but there is no more disturbance after that.

Perfectly displaying the quality that they should have as regular troops who have received rigorous training, each of them is tightly united under the command of their commander, and they line up to wait for orders.

And Yoshinari Tomita didn't take care of the soldiers after shocking them, because he knew that with the foundation of previous training, coupled with the huge army of officers, it was enough to stabilize the morale of these soldiers and clean up the discipline.

He has more important things to do now.
